name: Kana ~Imouto~
source:
Kana has a terrible disease and has spent most of her life in and out of the hospital. Takamichi Toudou, her older brother, would do anything to make her well. When he learns the terrible news that Kana can only live another six months at most, his frustration and powerlessness come to a boil. Despite the jealous attention of his girlfriend, Yumi, he starts to experience feelings of romantic love for his sister... especially after he discovers his family's secret. Will he seek for a way to save Kana, or surrender to her destiny, spending the last of their time together?

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/games/gc002/kana]JAST USA[/url]]
translation:
藤堂加奈身患重病，大半生都在医院里反复住院、出院。哥哥藤堂隆道愿意付出一切，只求她能够康复。当隆道得知加奈最多只剩六个月生命时，挫败与无力感终于濒临极限。尽管女友夕美因嫉妒而紧盯着他，他却开始察觉自己对妹妹怀有男女之情……尤其是在发现家族的秘密之后。他会设法挽救加奈，还是接受她的命运，陪她度过最后的时光？

[摘自[url=https://jastusa.com/games/gc002/kana]JAST USA[/url]]
